test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The income of Raman is ₹45,000. He saves 12.5% of his income. If his income increases by 18% and expenditure increases by 20%, then his savings will:
solution:
Given:

The income of Raman is ₹45,000. He saves 12.5% of his income.

Later his income increases by 18% and the expenditure increases by 20%,

Concept used:

Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

Expenditure = (100 - 12.5%) of 45,000

⇒ 45000 × 7/8 = Rs. 39375

Savings = 45000 - 39375 = 5625

Now, his income after 18% increment = 45000 + 18% of 45,000

⇒ 45000 + 8100

⇒ Rs. 53,100

His expenditure after 20% increment = 39375 + 20% of 39375

⇒ 47250

His savings becomes = 53100 - 47250

⇒ Rs. 5850

Now, his savings increased by = 5850 - 5625

⇒ Rs. 225

∴ His savings increased by Rs. 225.
